desc:
Titan Battlefronts is a fast-paced Roblox game where players clash in massive battles. Fight, survive, and dominate the battlefield!

By @S4R_27633

Tips:
- To aim, move your mouse. If you’re on mobile, aim by moving the camera.
- for some abilities you must hold down the bind or skill button. if you release it, the ability will stop
- use shift lock for melee fights. Turn it off for shooting abilities so they’re easier to aim.

⚠️ This game is currently in testing. You may encounter bugs or unfinished features. Please report any issues to the developers via direct messages or the official socials.
